Section Header: Baseline screening (the reference form — no rules of its own)
Field Note: Auto-assigned. Enrol on this form FIRST — every other form compares against it.
e.g. TB-2026-0042. The Diagnosis form makes you retype this and must match.
The first date in the chain. Every later date must be on or after this one.
Whole years. The Diagnosis form re-asks this and must match exactly (numeric).
Decimal allowed, e.g. 54.5. The Outcome form compares final weight against this.
Set this to Positive to switch ON the conditional rules on Diagnosis and Treatment.

Field Note: Coded value. Treatment site must match this — shows that CODED fields compare on the CODE.

Section Header: Same-form control (always live — your baseline for comparison)
Field Note: Type any number, e.g. 10. The field below is checked against THIS one, on the same form.

Field Label: CONTROL — must be >= the local minimum
Field Note: Both fields are on THIS form, so this check is always live as you type, whatever the module version or your rights. Compare its behaviour with the cross-form fields.

Section Header: Identity check — TEXT equality across forms
Field Note: Must equal scr_participant_id on the Screening form. Text compares exactly (case and punctuation included).
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[dx_participant_id_confirm]=[scr_participant_id]","message":"Does not match the Participant ID recorded at screening","blockSave":"hard"}

Field Note: Must equal scr_age. Both sides look numeric, so this is a NUMERIC comparison — 007 and 7 are equal here, unlike the text field above.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[dx_age_confirm]=[scr_age]","message":"Does not match the age recorded at screening","blockSave":"hard"}

Section Header: Date chain — must not run backwards
Field Note: Must be on or after the SCREENING date (a different form).
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[dx_specimen_date]>=[scr_screen_date]","message":"Specimen cannot be collected before the screening date","blockSave":"hard"}

Field Note: Must be on or after the specimen date — both on THIS form, so this one is always live. Contrast it with the field above.

Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, MTB detected | 2, MTB not detected | 3, Error / Invalid

Section Header: Conditional rule — only enforced for HIV-positive participants
Field Note: Only checked when scr_hiv_status = Positive on the Screening form. A CD4 of 0 is refused as implausible while that gate is on; set HIV status to Negative and the rule goes inert.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[dx_cd4]>'0'","when":"[scr_hiv_status]='1'","message":"A CD4 count is implausible for an HIV-positive participant","blockSave":"off"}

Section Header: Date chain — spans TWO forms back
Field Note: Must be on or after the RESULT date on the Diagnosis form.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[tx_start_date]>=[dx_result_date]","message":"Treatment cannot start before the diagnosis result date","blockSave":"hard"}

Section Header: Numeric ceiling — set on the Screening form
Field Note: Must not exceed scr_max_daily_dose, recorded two forms back. Decimal comparison.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[tx_daily_dose_mg]<=[scr_max_daily_dose]","message":"Daily dose exceeds the protocol maximum recorded at screening","blockSave":"hard"}

Section Header: Coded value — compares on the CODE, not the label
Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, Bamenda Regional Hospital | 2, Douala Laquintinie | 3, Yaounde Jamot
Field Note: Must match the screening site. Codes are compared (1/2/3), so relabelling a choice does not change the rule.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[tx_site]=[scr_site]","message":"Treatment site differs from the screening site","blockSave":"off"}

Section Header: Conditional rule — gated on a field two forms back
Field Note: Only enforced once consent is Yes AND HIV status is Positive on the Screening form. Flip either and the rule goes inert.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[tx_art_started]='1'","when":"[scr_consent]='1' and [scr_hiv_status]='1'","message":"ART must be started for a consented HIV-positive participant","blockSave":"off"}

Field Note: Type any number. The field below is checked against THIS one, on the same form.

Field Label: CONTROL — must be >= the local floor
Field Note: Always live as you type — the comparison never leaves this page.

Section Header: Final link in the date chain
Field Note: Must be on or after the treatment start date on the Treatment form.

Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, Cured | 2, Treatment completed | 3, Treatment failed | 4, Died | 5, Lost to follow-up

Section Header: Numeric comparison against the baseline, only for a cure
Field Note: Only checked when the outcome is Cured: a cured participant is not expected to weigh less than at screening. Warning only — it never blocks the save.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[out_final_weight_kg]>=[scr_weight_kg]","when":"[out_result]='1'","message":"A cured participant weighs less than at screening — please confirm","blockSave":"off"}

Field Note: Must equal the Participant ID from Screening — the same text check as on Diagnosis, but now three forms away.
Field Annotation: @UVASSERT={"assert":"[out_id_confirm]=[scr_participant_id]","message":"Does not match the Participant ID recorded at screening","blockSave":"hard"}
